answers.description: Industrial mining-operations portal and operations dashboard
answers.problem_statement: Fragmentation and latency across industrial mining departments (drilling, production, safety, plant control) needing unified real-time operational dashboards
answers.target_users: Mining operators, control room engineers, safety officers, and department managers across Plantcor facilities
answers.key_goals: 1. Real-time telemetry & operational status across 8 departments; 2. Robust zero-trust role/department access control via Supabase RLS; 3. Sub-second dashboard interactions with high reliability
answers.design_principles: Reliability & User Safety, Strict Data Boundaries (RLS/Auth), Performance First (Sub-second latency)
answers.backend_framework: NestJS 11 on Fastify 5 + Next.js Route Handlers / Server Actions + Payload CMS v3
answers.database: PostgreSQL (Supabase with mandatory RLS) + Kysely query builder + Redis
answers.infrastructure: Docker (Local dev & production containers) / Self-hosted Linux & Cloud services
answers.tdd_strictness: Moderate - tests encouraged, required before merging / closing tracks
